audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says the lane 'turns at 6' and that his true damage 'bites through your bruiser stats', but never says the one thing that changes: Highlander switches off Ambessa's only sticking tool.
audit.why: Riot's text: Highlander 'temporarily increas[es] his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects.' Lacerate's slow is what holds him inside a Q-into-empowered-auto chain. From 6 onward, for the duration of his ultimate, that slow does nothing at all — the lane does not just get harder, her pattern loses a component.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[1].text, mid and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: There is not a single cooldown number anywhere in this matchup — the recorded defect for it — so every 'fight here, not there' instruction is untimeable.
audit.why: The numbers that decide it are all flat or nearly flat: Alpha Strike 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 (and basic attacks reduce it), Meditate a flat 10, Wuju Style a flat 14, Highlander a flat 85. Against Ambessa's Public Execution at 130 at rank 1, his ultimate comes back roughly half again as often as hers — that asymmetry is the whole reason the late game is his.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, early, mid, whys[2], whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is never named, so nothing tells the player what Public Execution is actually best spent on after lane.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time.' The kit derives a channel flag from it, and the flat 10-second cooldown makes it a repeatable out. Public Execution suppresses on arrival, and a suppressed champion cannot keep channelling — one R cancels the heal outright. Grievous Wounds cuts what does get through.
audit.corrected: Added to late, whys[6] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text, early and whys[2] all build the level-3 window around 'the full E stun combo'. Ambessa has no stun before level 6.
audit.why: Riot's text: Lacerate 'whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies'. It slows; it does not stun. Her only stun is the Public Execution slam at 6. Telling a player they hold a level-3 stun changes how they commit.
audit.corrected: All three now say Lacerate's slow into Q and Sundering Slam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike is never named, so 'he has no tool to punish or escape it' at level 3 is stated as fact when he has exactly one.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed... while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.' It is 20 seconds at rank 1 and shrinking with every auto he lands. The honest version of the level-3 window is that his out is on a long cooldown, not that he has none — and that spending burst into the untargetable window wastes it.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, early, whys[2] and wants.foe[2] now name it with its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Wuju DPS' and 'Wuju points' are used as if armour were the counter.
audit.why: Riot's text: Wuju Style 'grants bonus true damage on basic attacks'. True damage ignores armour, so stacking resistances against that portion buys nothing. Health, damage reduction and simply not being in range for the duration are the answers, alongside Grievous Wounds for Meditate.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and spikes[2].text now say true damage explicitly.

notes: There is no CHAMP_FULL['ambessa']['masteryi'] entry — Master Yi exists only in the content layer for this champion, so every edit here is content. That is worth checking on the site: if the full layer renders the matchup page, this one has nothing behind it. The recorded defect (no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere) was accurate; the matchup now carries Alpha Strike 20s, Meditate 10s, Wuju Style 14s and Highlander 85s against Public Execution's 130s. Two claims I removed rather than kept: Ambessa has no level-3 stun (Lacerate slows), and armour does nothing against Wuju Style's true damage.
